title: Exa API key (no evidenced shape): one-property twin (context)
summary: 8 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: EXA_API_KEY renamed EXA_API_KEY_ID, a documented identifier field; the value is kept byte-for-byte, context: EXA_API_KEY renamed EXA_KEY_ID, a documented identifier field; the value is kept byte-for-byte, and context: the Exa constructor replaced by an unrelated Widget constructor; the value is kept byte-for-byte, and 3 more. Twin of "Exa API key (no evidenced shape): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of exa-api-key-curl-x-api-key: context: the api.exa.ai host replaced by api.example.invalid, so no Exa name remains on the line; the value is kept byte-for-byte. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
